findings.summary: Repeated scan/status failures prefer stale durable status over newer volatile state, so observed/dropped/missing counters stop accumulating.
Malformed .log entries raise uncaught ValueError through append/status instead of returning a failure snapshot and preserving observation.

acceptance.C-AC-24: fixture-level cap, exact-prefix, concurrency, reopen accounting, preservation and path-safety behavior accepted
acceptance.C-AC-28: not accepted until repeated-failure accounting and malformed-entry exception propagation are corrected

residual_integration_risk: CW-15 still owns actual PTY stream wiring, independent drain/display continuity, durable metadata admission recovery, restart restoration and UI status exposure.
